s2:A Six Year, Low-resolution, Multibroadband Transit Photometry Study of HD 189733, 2022-12-06

rationale: The paper 'PLATON II: New Capabilities And A Comprehensive Retrieval on HD 189733b Transit and Eclipse Data' directly investigates the joint analysis of transit and secondary eclipse data for HD 189733b, contributing substantive new evidence on the question by expanding the capabilities of the PLATON tool to include secondary eclipse depths and updating opacities, which are relevant for understanding CO presence in the day-side spectrum.
